name: XVideos
summary: High-traffic free tube rival to Pornhub with a stripped-down fast player, huge international catalog, and an optional XVideos RED paid tier.
ranking_rationale: Consistent global traffic leader with quick video startup and deep international uploads; held back by dated UI, aggressive mobile ads, and uneven tagging.

pricing.model: Ad-supported free tube + optional paid tier (XVideos RED)
pricing.free_tier: Full free tube library with ads
pricing.notes: Core tube is free; XVideos RED ad-free and studio tier varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Massive global library across amateur and studio clips
Lightweight player loads quickly even on slow connections
Strong international and non-English category depth
Optional XVideos RED tier strips ads and unlocks full scenes
cons: Dated visual layout and cluttered browse grid
Aggressive banner and pop-under ads on mobile web
Search tagging and duplicate uploads can be messy

facts.value: Free ad-supported streaming with optional XVideos RED membership
Minimalist HTML5 player with fast scrubbing and huge international reach
